art_direction: Editorial, premium, traditional aesthetic with quiet luxury spacing, modular magazine-like composition, and smooth scroll motion. Uses temple gopuram motifs, watercolor lotus/marigold, banana leaves, and gold foil aesthetics over a cream parchment background.

headings.usage: H1 for Kinetic Hero ('Sindhuja & Pradeep'), H2 for section titles. Elegant, high-contrast serif to convey traditional calligraphy.

body.usage: Paragraphs, venue details, RSVP form labels. Provides modern, clean contrast to the ornate serif headings.

accents.usage: For numbered manifesto chapters (01, 02) and subtle sub-headlines or dates (Thula Lagnam).

background.description: Warm ivory/cream parchment. DO NOT use dark mode. All sections must use variations of cream/ivory.

surface.description: Subtle darker cream for cards, RSVP container, or gallery background.

text.description: Deep maroon/temple-brown for high contrast legibility.

accents.description: Use gold for subtle borders, marquee text, icons. Maroon for buttons/CTAs. Sage green for subtle botanical leaf accents.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use soft ambient shadows for gallery images only: drop-shadow(0 10px 20px rgba(45, 27, 27, 0.05))
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-none or max 4px for specific clipped frames to keep the editorial/magazine feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise/grain overlay globally (`mix-blend-multiply opacity-20`) or parchment paper background for depth.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-24, py-32 to create Awwwards-level breathing room.
layouts.hero: 100vh container. Central kinetic typography block. Use absolute positioned subtle watercolor elements (lotus/banana leaf) floating at the edges.
layouts.manifesto_chapters: Grid 12-column. Asymmetrical. Chapter number (e.g., '01') takes 4 columns, content/image takes 6-8 columns. Adds editorial tension.
layouts.gallery: Bento-style or masonry overlapping clipped frames. Spotlight effect on hover.
layouts.venue: Split screen: Left side beautiful typography and details, right side embedded Google Maps wrapped in a traditional arched or rectangular gold frame.

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis is MANDATORY. Initialize Lenis for the entire app.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer-motion masked line-by-line reveal for 'Sindhuja & Pradeep'. Split text into lines, overflow-hidden wrapper, staggerChildren 0.15s, duration 1s, ease [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], start at y: '110%'.
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer-motion `whileInView`. Elements should fade in and drift up (y: 30 to 0) as they enter viewport.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the background watercolor elements (lotus, temple gopuram) using Framer Motion `useScroll` and `useTransform`.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee separating sections using `react-fast-marquee`. Low contrast gold text, serif, separated by lotus icons.

sections.name: Kinetic Hero
sections.description: Immersive hero, huge text 'Sindhuja & Pradeep', masked reveal. Background has subtle parchment texture and 3D/parallax floating lotus elements.

sections.name: Marquee Separator
sections.description: Slow, elegant scrolling text: '✦ 26 AUGUST 2026 ✦ THULA LAGNAM ✦ N.K.N.R. GARDENS ✦'

sections.name: 01. The Invitation (Chapter)
sections.description: Numbered chapter '01'. Heartfelt invitation message from families, elegant typography, large negative space.

sections.name: 02. Muhurtham & Countdown
sections.description: Live countdown to 26 Aug 2026, 11:24 AM. Minimalist numbers, serif font, separated by colons.

sections.name: 03. Events & Venues
sections.description: Wedding & Reception details. Includes Google Maps embed in a framed component.

sections.name: 04. Gallery
sections.description: Real product photography style frames with couple photos and traditional Indian wedding aesthetics. Overlapping layout.

sections.name: 05. RSVP & Wishes
sections.description: Interactive form (Name, Attending Count, Message) and a guest wishes wall.

rsvp_form.style: Minimalist inputs, transparent background with gold bottom border (`border-b border-[#D4AF37]`), no heavy boxes. Submit button maroon with gold text, sharp corners, hover effect.
rsvp_form.interactions: Focus states increase border opacity. Form submission shows success toast using `sonner`.

temple_architecture.description: Traditional temple architecture for venue context

lotus_watercolor.description: Lotus watercolor element for parallax accents

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.1: Do not create generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical, modular magazine-style composition (editorial web design) to match Awwwards aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.2: Ensure generous spacing (p-12, py-24). Allow the text and images to breathe.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.3: Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, scroll-reveals with framer-motion.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.4: No transparent dropdowns or unreadable overlays.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.5: Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.6: Add `data-testid` to all interactive and key informational elements (e.g., `data-testid='rsvp-submit-button'`, `data-testid='countdown-timer'`).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.7: Use `sonner` for toast notifications in RSVP form.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.8: NEVER use placeholder URLs or AI emoji characters. Use provided image_urls.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup @studio-freight/lenis for smooth scrolling in the main layout.
Use framer-motion heavily. The Hero component MUST feature a kinetic masked line-by-line reveal.
Install react-fast-marquee for the slow editorial ribbon.
Use lucide-react for minimal icons (e.g., map-pin, clock).
Tailwind: Customize tailwind.config.js to include Cormorant Garamond, Outfit, and Americana color palette (Ivory/Gold/Maroon).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure deep maroon text on cream background passes WCAG 2.1 AA.
